text:
Adrian: kicking off a tiny canary for `quant4-v3` — shadowed for a day, now planning 2% traffic canary. saw a small signal on long-context prompts in shadow.
Maya: can you paste the shadow slice numbers? which metric moved?
Adrian: quick summary: overall top-1 quality looks fine, but on the 2k+ token slice MRR dropped ~1.8% vs baseline (float16) with p~0.03. hallucination proxies (entity-mention divergence) up ~2.4%.
Sasha: that's concerning for our feed summarization customers. was it consistent across sampling seeds or concentrated on a few prompts?
Adrian: fairly consistent across seeds, looks correlated with long-turn retrieval prompts (the ones with >6 embedded documents). small increase in repetition tokens too.
Tian: do we have tokenizer/position-embedding mismatch on quant path? sometimes int4 kernels truncate attention windows slightly differently.
Adrian: checked model logs, kv-cache alignment looks fine. suspect subtle distribution shift from quantized attention scaling at long seq lengths.
eva-qa: I ran a quick A/B on a 400-sample long-doc holdout: baseline 0.482 MRR, quant4-v3 0.473. CI excludes 0. So threshold breach if we use 1.5% delta guard.
Maya: propose we change canary plan: start at 0% traffic but warm canary instances (shadow+small internal traffic) while we run targeted stress evals. Auto-fallback rule: block promotion if MRR delta > 1.0% sustained for 30m or hallucination proxy delta >1.5%.
Sasha: alternative quick mitigation: route short queries (<512 tokens) to quant4-v3 for cost wins and keep long queries pinned to float16 until we fix.
Adrian: good call. I can add a route-based policy: `route_by_seq_len: {"<512": "quant4-v3", ">=512": "baseline-fp16"}` and re-run smoke.
Adrian: config snippet I plan to apply:
```json
{
  "canary_pct": 0,
  "shadow": true,
  "route_by_seq_len": {"lt_512": "quant4-v3", "gte_512": "baseline-fp16"},
  "auto_fallback": {"mrr_delta_pct": 1.0, "hallucination_delta_pct": 1.5, "window_minutes": 30}
}
```
Tian: sounds safe. can we also enable a lightweight rerank fallback for long queries (run quant4-v3 then rerank with fp16 candidate scoring)? cost hit but only for long tail.
eva-qa: we should add a dedicated long-doc eval set to the rollout dashboard so ops can see the pulse in realtime.
deploy-bot: Canary instances launched in shadow mode for `quant4-v3` — traffic routing set to internal only.
Adrian: I'll hold on promoting. running extra evals and a reranker PoC. will update in 2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya: thanks — set alert on long-doc MRR delta > 0.8% too, just to be conservative.
Adrian: done, alerts wired. pausing public canary until we validate rerank mitigation.
